Only macOS and Linux export servers are supported. Keep allow_local=false for NAS; do not bypass the network mount check to address an unavailable share.

artifact_runtime.private_content_unavailable: This fixed content cannot be read securely from the current storage provider. Ask an administrator to restore protected file storage.
artifact_runtime.private_storage_required: Protected file storage must be configured by an administrator before capturing new files. You can submit text or keep attachments in the production issue meanwhile.
artifact_runtime.verification_timeout: Verification timed out. Check the file storage connection and try again.
artifact_runtime.node_unavailable: The selected work item is no longer an eligible L3. Check its structure and project/module binding.
artifact_runtime.return_hint: The designated reviewer can still request changes or reject with feedback.
artifact_runtime.capture_not_ready: The fixed copy is not ready yet. Check the capture state before reviewing.
artifact_runtime.content_mismatch: The stored content does not match its fixed fingerprint. Ask the storage administrator to inspect it; corrections must use a new version.
artifact_runtime.storage_unavailable: Storage is temporarily unavailable. Restore access and verify again.
artifact_runtime.content_unavailable: The fixed content cannot be retrieved. Review the production issue for recovery or a replacement version.
artifact_runtime.new_revision_hint: Creates a backlog issue and assigns production responsibility in one operation. No agent run starts automatically.
artifact_runtime.criteria_manager_hint: A workspace owner or administrator must define the first acceptance criteria.
artifact_runtime.open_producer: Open production issue to revise or upload
artifact_runtime.producer_rebase: The draft keeps its original production issue. Confirm the current responsibility to continue; an attachment from the former issue will be cleared.
artifact_runtime.meeting_source_hint: Choose a published minutes version to fix the meeting record used as a source. A meeting alone does not freeze its editable notes.
artifact_runtime.version_changed: The recorded responsibility or version has changed. Refresh before making a formal decision; your draft is retained.
artifact_runtime.review_changed: Review responsibility changed while this draft was open. The previous feedback remains available below.
artifact_runtime.content_missing: The fixed content could not be verified. Existing decisions are retained; a pending version cannot be approved while unavailable.
artifact_runtime.evidence_missing: Some fixed evidence could not be verified. Existing decisions are retained; pending acceptance cannot be approved while unavailable.
artifact_runtime.command_changed: The context changed while this form was open. Close and reopen it to review the latest facts.
artifact_runtime.confirm_responsibility: I confirm this transfer and its effect on the current responsibility.
artifact_runtime.transfer_active_hint: The fixed content stays unchanged. A pending review is assigned to a new human review issue; the former responsibility ends. Versions still being captured change reviewer without creating a review issue.
artifact_runtime.transfer_future_hint: This changes the default reviewer for future versions. Completed reviews remain unchanged.
artifact_runtime.transfer_acceptance_hint: This transfers the current pending acceptance to a new human review issue. Its conditions, evidence and historical decisions remain unchanged.
artifact_runtime.producer_hint: Only the chosen issue may submit future versions. Existing versions and runs remain unchanged; reusing an issue preserves its scope, assignee and status.
artifact_runtime.archive_hint: Archiving preserves fixed versions, decisions and references. Restore it before submitting new work.
artifact_runtime.reference_hint: A reference keeps the chosen version. It does not move ownership, approve the version or grant submission rights.
artifact_runtime.not_current_evidence: This is not the current approved version eligible for acceptance.
artifact_runtime.remove_reference_hint: This removes the active reference. Historical records and evidence already used in acceptance remain unchanged.
artifact_runtime.add_node_reference: Reference a version from an L3
artifact_runtime.add_meeting_reference: Reference a version from a meeting
artifact_runtime.workspace_reference: Choose a target in this workspace. References can cross project and module boundaries without moving the artifact.
artifact_runtime.confirm_reference: I confirm the selected fixed version and destination.
